image_description: A large, ornate pipe organ situated in a church loft or gallery. The instrument features a symmetrical arrangement of vertical metal pipes of varying heights, with the tallest pipes forming a central peak and shorter pipes flanking them. The organ case is constructed of light-colored wood with gold accents and decorative carvings. Below the main pipe array is a balcony railing. Through the arches below the organ, windows are visible, letting in bright daylight. The surrounding architecture includes stone columns and vaulted ceilings typical of Gothic or Neo-Gothic style.
